title: Best-Response Invariance
body_html:
Best-Response Invariance

A solution or selection concept is best-response invariant if two games with the same best-response correspondence have the same solution set.

The set of Nash equilibria and the set of rationalizable strategies are best-response invariant.

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 4.10.2] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MathFoundationsGameTheory.pdf. BR-invariance for equilibrium selection.
